name: nomos-1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507: 48 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, not a new base model: same config.json, same 30.532 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-12-07. CAVEAT: the 87/120 headline is measured INSIDE the Nomos reasoning harness the authors open-sourced alongside the model; the card's comparison runs the base through the same harness, so the pairing is fair, but the score is model+harness and does not describe bare-model capability. Single benchmark, no sample count or repeat count printed.

benchmarks.name: Putnam 2025 (/120)
benchmarks.config: Card prose (no table): 'On Putnam 2025, Nomos 1 scores 87/120 when wrapped in the Nomos reasoning harness. Under the same conditions, Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 scores 24/120.' Both models wrapped in the same open-source Nomos harness (github.com/NousResearch/nomos), so the number is model+harness, not bare model. No sample count, decoding configs or repeats printed.
